profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at deciBel Research, Inc.
profile.summary:
Mr. Miller has over 20 years experience in software development using several different software languages and computer operating systems.  Mr. Miller has also supported program management functions and software testing.

Specialties: Active Clearances available upon request

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer.
Project: FY24 Platform Development
Skill Set:  Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Kargo, Argo CD, Grafana, ISTIO, other apps
Summary:  Mr. Miller provides development and installation knowledge on the NOVASTAR contract for National Air and Space Intelligence Center’s Geospatial & Signatures Intelligence Group (NASIC/GS).  He installed setup and configured OpenTelemetry for Logs, Metrics, and Traces as part of the Kubernetes environment.  Mr. Miller also worked with several other apps such as Argo Cd and Kargo to monitor and help with the CI/CD for the project.  Mr. Miller has experience working in a local Kubernetes Cluster using Rancher Desktop as well as a Factory cluster.  He is responsible for setting up and modifying Kustomize installations for multiple projects.

Project:  WSRM
Skill Set:  C++, Docker, Postgres, Node js, ActiveMQ, sqLite
Summary:  Mr. Miller has supported the WSRM project while employed with Decibel.  Mr. Miller has written several backend dockers to support the loading of data into a postgres database from the node js server.  He has also written several C++ functions to support the logging of information into files and deployed them as dockers.  Mr. Miller has written and modified active MQ messages that are passed between the C++ functions and the node js server.  Mr. Miller wrote standalone applications to load the database with data by reading a file in a specified format and deployed this as a standalone executable for the system.  He created another executable that will read a json file and put the data into the corresponding postgres table structure.  Mr. Miller came up with the database table structure to move the current postgres database to a sqlite database structure and worked on modifying the code to work with the new sqlite database.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Applied Research Solutions,  Beavercreek/Ohio
Project Manager / Software Engineer				      Aug 2013 – Present
Project: MASINT Portal, Sensor Web
Skill Set:  JAVA, JSP, Oracle, Eclipse, GateIn
Summary:  Mr. Miller serves as the project manager for the MASINT Portal and Sensor Web projects.  Mr. Miller also supports program management functions on other projects as needed.  Mr. Miller also served as a software engineer working on the MASINT Portal project.
• Creates and Updates Schedules using Microsoft Project
• Maintains metrics associated with both projects
• Interfaces with the customer and the prime contractor on all management aspects of projects
• Performs all other project management activities associated with projects	
• Updated the code to work in the GateIn framework.
• Added new portlets in the GateIn framework.
• Updated and added JSP Pages to support multiple web browsers.
• Wrote interfaces to the Oracle database for information needed by the application.
• Designed, implemented, and modified Oracle database tables and queries 
• Followed software development processes for the software lifecycle and the Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) standards.
• Wrote change packets that include Requirement, Design, and Test procedures for new functionality following the standard SEI CMMI Level 3 compliant processes. 
• Designed, coded and implemented WSDLs and Web Services to access and display data from other systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead – GRACAR Corporation 
Project: Smart Systems
Skill Set:  MS Access, Oracle, Wherenet Scripting, Excel, MS Word
Summary:  Mr. Miller served as a Technical lead working on the Smart Systems project.  
• Designed databases and forms for questionnaires using Microsoft Access.
• Supported the creation of several technical documents for release to the customer.
• Created scripts using wherenet software to simulate the movement of RFID tags to support field tests of the software
• Installed custom applications on servers to be tested at different locations.

Software Developer – General Dynamics 
Project: Space Base Infrared Systems (SBIRS)
Skill Set:  C, C#, Oracle, PERL
Summary:  Mr. Miller served as a Software Engineer working on the SBIRS system while subcontracted to General Dynamics (GD).  Mr. Miller uses the .NET architecture with C# to design and implement new applications for the SBIRS system.  
• Coded and tested all aspects of these applications from the user interface screens to the database updates.
• Used an Oracle database to store all of the information
• Used PERL to scrape web pages to get some of the information.
• Site lead of personnel working for GRACAR at GD providing communication to and from management.
• Tracked money and hours for the GRACAR on the SBIRS project
• Created weekly and monthly status reports that were deliverables to the customer
• Created and briefed contract review slides.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer – Reynolds and Reynolds 
Project: Multi-Select System
Skill Set:  T-SQL, SQL Server 2000
Summary:  Mr. Miller served as a Software Engineer working on the Multi-Select system while subcontracted to Reynolds and Reynolds.  
• Used T-SQL in SQL Server 2000 to design, code, and implement stored procedures.
• Wrote stored procedures to transfer data from the old table structure to the new table structure.

Software Developer – CSC Corp 
Project: Modernization of the Stock Control System (SCS) Readiness Based leveling (RBL)
Skill Set:  C++, Oracle 9i
Summary:  Mr. Miller served as a Software Engineer working on the Modernization of the Stock Control System (SCS) while subcontracted to Computer Science Corporation (CSC). He is a member of the Readiness Based Leveling (RBL) increment of the SCS project.   
• Used Objected-Oriented C++ and Interface definition Language (IDL) to design, code, and implement the software applications.
• Created Stored procedures for the Oracle database to store, update, and delete information from the database.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Programs used by County Offices, Programs for ALCAN
Skill Set:  Visual Basic, Access Database, Oracle, Seagate Crystal Reports 
Summary:  Mr. Miller served as a Computer Systems Analyst developing graphical user interface (GUI) software for several different programs used by county offices.    
• Utilization of Visual Basic in a Windows 98 and Windows NT environment to develop the GUI.
• Creation of the interface between Access database and users.
• Utilized and developed classes for the Data access layer, Business object layer, and the Application layer.
• Created generic and specific reports utilizing the Oracle database and Seagate Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Funds Allocation System (FAS) 
Skill Set:  Visual FoxPro, SQL Server 2000 
Summary:  Mr. Miller served as a Computer Systems Analyst developing graphical user interface (GUI) software for the Funds Allocation System (FAS).  
• Utilization of Visual Foxpro in a Windows 95 environment to develop the GUI.
• Creation of the interface between the Foxpro databases and users.
• Duties included converting and interfacing SQL server for database system management and facilitated transition from local databases to SQL server database tables.

Project: Staff Action Software  
Skill Set:  Visual Basic, Oracle, MS Access
Summary:  Mr. Miller supported implementation of the Staff Action software installed in the DO and SC sections of AFMC. Duties included installing the product, training of users, and coding custom applications.  
• Developed custom applications that automated portions of the install procedure
• Wrote custom applications that updated information in the database, including SQL statements.
• Constructed detailed instruction guide for the installation process.
• Used Microsoft Access and Access forms to create customized reports for user.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Navy ES-3A Ground maintenance Prcessor (GMP) 
Skill Set:  Visual C++ 
Summary:  Mr. Miller served as a System Analyst developing graphical user interface (GUI) software for the ES-3A Ground Maintenance Processor (GMP) project.  
• Utilization of Visual C++ in a Windows environment to create, format, and build disk software.
• For Windows framework commonality, the AppWizard tool was used, and the Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC) and AppStudio tools were used to create dialogs, alerts and other user interfaces.

Project: F15-E simulator on-site at McDonnell Douglas (St. Louis, MO) 
Skill Set:  Fortran 
Summary:   As a software engineer Mr. Miller supported the development of the radar altimeter (CARA) and Target Pod (LANTIRN) systems.  
• Used FORTRAN systems programming designed for Power PC use with a VME Chassis and VxWorks operating system.
• Interface creation of VME Chassis and VxWorks with other simulator systems, such as the graphics program and the Central Computer (CC).

Project: PC Support Software (PCSS) for the ES-3A Fleet Issue 4 
Skill Set:  Visual C++ 
Summary:  As a software engineer Mr. Miller supported the PC Support Software (PCSS) for the ES-3A Fleet Issue 4 project.  The PCSS is used for CM of the Operational Flight Program (OFP) and the System Maintenance Program (SMP).  
• Developed the program to install the PCSS software to the PC hard drive.
• Designed a program to update the autoexec.bat file used to restart the PC when building an aircraft disk for OFP or SMP purposes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: ES-3A Sensor System Improvement Program (SSIP) Advanced Development Model ADM)
Skill Set:  C++, Motif
Summary:  As a software engineer Mr. Miller used C++ language and Motif to develop an improved GUI prototype proof-of-concept version which migrated portions of the ES-3A legacy software to a UNIX-based open systems environment.  
• Delivered a GUI prototype for the AN/ALR-76 Automatic Electronic Support Measures (ESM) subsystem.
• Created interface messages and message flow diagrams, which documented the digital interface between the GUI hardware and the simulated mission computer.
